S.FORM: batad nu wali (kamu nu Hulam: 遠東 ) u katinengan nu salengacay a tademaw i "tipay" . u batad nu wali hananay ku sawalian nu "nutipan nu Europe" . i tepal ku "untipan nu Europe" , u "tepalay a wali" hananay. izaw ku "nuwalian nu O-Cuo" (East Europe, 東歐), "nuwalitimulan nu Europe" , "nuamisan nu Africa " atu Turkey . u "inutebanan nu walian" hananay izaw ku "nuwalian nu Africa" , Li-Fan-Te (黎凡特, Lavent ), A-La-Po pangkiw a subal atu "inutebanan nu Asia" . "batad nu wali" saan sa, namaka kakitidaan atu kitakit nu European a tademaw , u lala' i batad nu wali mueneng ku takuliyaway a tademaw . sakawalian sabataday a China , Korea North , atu Japan , u "nuwalian nu Asia" hananay. sisa u batad nu wali saan sa. izaw ku henay Siberia , u "nuamisan nu Asia" hananay, atu "walitimulan nu Asia" .
S.PHON: batad nu wa[r|ɾ]i kamu nu ħu[r|ɾ]am ** u katinəŋan nu sa[r|ɾ]əŋaʦaj a tadəmaw i tipaj u batad nu wa[r|ɾ]i ħananaj ku sawa[r|ɾ]ian nu nutipan nu əuropə i təpa[r|ɾ] ku untipan nu əuropə u təpa[r|ɾ]aj a wa[r|ɾ]i ħananaj izaw ku nuwa[r|ɾ]ian nu oʦuo əast əuropə ** nuwa[r|ɾ]itimu[r|ɾ]an nu əuropə nuamisan nu afriʦa atu turke u inutəbanan nu wa[r|ɾ]ian ħananaj izaw ku nuwa[r|ɾ]ian nu afriʦa [r|ɾ]ifantə *** [r|ɾ]a*ənt a[r|ɾ]apo paŋkiw a suba[r|ɾ] atu inutəbanan nu asia batad nu wa[r|ɾ]i saan sa namaka kakitidaan atu kitakit nu əuropəan a tadəmaw u [r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]a[ʔ|ʡ] i batad nu wa[r|ɾ]i muənəŋ ku taku[r|ɾ]ijawaj a tadəmaw sakawa[r|ɾ]ian sabatadaj a ʦħina korəa nortħ atu *apan u nuwa[r|ɾ]ian nu asia ħananaj sisa u batad nu wa[r|ɾ]i saan sa izaw ku ħənaj sibəria u nuamisan nu asia ħananaj atu wa[r|ɾ]itimu[r|ɾ]an nu asia
